Impact Successful exploitation allows an unauthenticated attacker to inject arbitrary Proxy-Authorization headers into all proxied HTTP requests made by the affected application, effectively spoofing the proxy identity. This can result in proxy log poisoning (attacker credentials recorded instead of legitimate user credentials), access control bypass if the proxy enforces authentication-based policies, and credential injection amplification if transparent proxies forward the header upstream. Availability may also be impacted if the proxy rejects the injected credentials, causing legitimate requests to fail (GitHub Advisory).
